# netactuate_vpc_gateway_snat_rule (Resource)

Manages a VPC Gateway SNAT Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_gateway_snat_rule" "example" {
  ip_version = 4
  vpc_id     = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_version` (Number) IP version for this rule (4 or 6)
- `vpc_id` (Number) The ID of the parent VPC

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the rule
- `match_internal_cidr` (String) Internal VPC subnet CIDR to apply SNAT to. If not set, the API defaults to ::/0 or 0.0.0.0/0 (match all).
- `priority_after_rule_id` (Number) Place this rule after the given SNAT rule ID
- `priority_location` (String) Place this rule at "start" or "end" of the rule list
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to match (TCP, UDP, or ICMP)
- `translation_address_end` (String) Upper bound of the public IP range for SNAT translation. If not set, the API defaults to the bastion IP.
- `translation_address_start` (String) Lower bound of the public IP range for SNAT translation. If not set, the API defaults to the bastion IP.
- `translation_port_end` (Number) End of the translation port range
- `translation_port_start` (Number) Start of the translation port range

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rule_id` (Number) The SNAT rule ID assigned by the API

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_gateway_snat_rule.example 12345
```
